question: Can Path and/or SEION produce the final link-prediction ranking without using the TuckER decoder?

WARM_STARTED_DECODER_SUFFICIENCY.initialization: same seed-specific pretraining baseline B_s/best.pt; W1-W3 load overlapping representations and freeze the unused TuckER decoder; optimizer reset
WARM_STARTED_DECODER_SUFFICIENCY.claim_boundary: decoder sufficiency only; representations may contain TuckER-pretrained knowledge

END_TO_END_ARCHITECTURAL_SUFFICIENCY.claim_boundary: full architectural sufficiency only if the independent initialization and paired-state checks pass

standalone_design.score: positive learned per-relation scale times internally normalized branch score
standalone_design.base_decoder: zero contribution and frozen when standalone_mode is warm_started_decoder or end_to_end

SEION internal parameters have nonzero gradient on the first batch
initial standalone scores are finite and non-degenerate
